excerpt.zh: 某些第一次接触会给出选项，让我方选择如何进行接触事项。这些选择也会长期地影响同其他帝国的外交关系。
excerpt.en: Some First Contact missions will present options for how we wish to conduct matters. These choices can affect our diplomatic relationships with other empires for a long time.
